review_scope.blinding: Only materials and neutral responses A/B were read as inputs. No repository, score, identity, prior review, Board or model/provider evidence was accessed.
review_scope.order: Materials inspected and independent-calculations.json saved before either response was read.
review_scope.method: Python standard library csv, json and math; natural-log plug-in Shannon per core, equally weighted arithmetic means.

calculations.formula: H = -sum((n_i/N) * ln(n_i/N)) for positive n_i; arithmetic mean of per-core H, not pooled counts
calculations.identification: The materials do not define a shared size-fraction target in task.md. Common >150 um diversity is identified for both campaigns. 63–150 um was unpicked in 2017, so both-fractions 2017 and temporal change for both fractions are unidentified without assumptions. Dot is unobserved, not zero; nominal whole-row means compare different observation supports.

target_identification.assessment: The requested campaign-core Shannon mean lacks an explicit size-fraction target. The dictionary identifies complete observation of >150 um in both campaigns, permitting an explicitly conditional common-fraction comparison. It does not make that target uniquely intended. The 2017 both-fraction assemblage and its temporal difference are not identified. No missing-to-zero replacement is warranted.
target_identification.legitimate_responses: An explicitly qualified common-fraction estimate is scientifically acceptable. A justified unresolved answer that explains the unspecified target and unobserved 2017 fine fraction would also be legitimate.

A.numerical_accuracy: Both requested means exactly match independent common-fraction calculations at stored floating-point precision.
A.scientific_coverage: Explicitly states T01-T08/>150 um in assumptions, exclusions and summary; correctly distinguishes unpicked cells from zero and uses completed_with_assumptions. Therefore does not silently substitute the common-fraction estimate for a whole-assemblage estimate.
qualification_limitations: The phrase "inflate 2021 diversity artificially" is imprecise: 2021 all-fraction diversity is a valid observed quantity; the issue is unequal coverage across campaigns. This is a wording caveat, not a numerical or substantive failure of the explicitly restricted result.
The statement "toolkit has no Shannon method" cannot be verified from the packet. It is extraneous to the scientific result and was not accepted as evidence.
Could state more explicitly that whole-assemblage change remains unresolved and that the fraction restriction defines the target.

B.numerical_accuracy: Both requested means exactly match independent common-fraction calculations. The additional 2021 all-fraction mean 2.2501 and restricted mean 1.9395 are correct to four decimal places.
B.scientific_coverage: Explicitly states T01-T08/>150 um in assumptions, exclusions and summary; correctly treats 2017 fine-fraction dots as missing and explains that full 2021 coverage is not comparable to 2017. Uses completed_with_assumptions appropriately.
qualification_limitations: Could state explicitly that a both-fraction temporal change remains unresolved; the present restriction and comparability warning nevertheless qualify the supplied results sufficiently.

comparison.reason: B quantifies the difference in 2021 size-fraction coverage and avoids describing the valid full-coverage Shannon value as artificial. This modest explanatory advantage does not justify rejecting A.

verification.independent_algebraic_check: H = ln(N) - sum(n_i*ln(n_i))/N, evaluated with math.fsum for each common-fraction core

limitations: No unavailable 2017 fine-fraction counts were inferred or imputed.
No confidence intervals, significance or population-level temporal trend was inferred from the descriptive means.
The packet does not verify collection-site comparability or any other unreported design features; comparability here refers specifically to taxonomic/size-fraction coverage.
Toolkit availability and execution provenance of the original responses were outside the supplied evidence.
